coaching_note: This call is missing the core selling framework: no two-concerns discovery, no promises (On-Time Guarantee or Damage Coverage), no pricing framing or value positioning, no rate-lock offer, and no explicit ask for the business — it ends instead with a polite throwaway question that allows the customer to say no by saying nothing.
